# Vision Foundations for Tactile Representation

Investigating Vision Foundational Models for Tactile Representation Learning

**2023-04-30 · Preprint · University of Cambridge; Institute for Infocomm Research, A*STAR; Carnegie Mellon University**

**[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.00596)**

Transforms heterogeneous tactile readings into image-like representations so a common pretrained visual backbone can learn touch tasks across sensor designs.

| Field | Reported value and source scope |

**Scope and qualifications**

- Time-series tactile readings are transformed into images; that transformation does not add an RGB camera or depth sensor.
- A common network architecture and sensor transfer experiments do not establish sensor-free calibration or autonomous robot control.

**Primary evidence**

1. [Original paper and first-public date](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.00596) — Sections III–V; model is MetaDataset-pretrained ResNet-18, not an ImageNet-only backbone.
